title: Yoga + Wine in Paradise
description: One more magical evening among the vines.
long_description:
One more magical evening among the vines.

About this Event

Join us in paradise for an unforgettable sunset yoga experience at Paradise Springs Winery in Clifton, VA. Slow down, breathe, and flow through an all-levels outdoor class surrounded by vineyard views, then linger a little longer with a glass of award-winning wine and great company. Come for the movement, stay for the magic of the moment. This is our final vineyard class of the season. Namaste & Cheers.
Each $38 ticket includes yoga and a glass of wine. BYO mat.
Yoga taught with love and laughs by Erin Sonn, M.Ed., ERYT, owner of , offering yoga and mindfulness experiences in nontraditional spaces.
